vulnerability.name: USN-9132-1
vulnerability.description: Dileep Kumar Jallepalli discovered that apng2gif incorrectly handled loading APNG files, leading to an integer overflow and a heap-based buffer over-read. If a user or automated system were tricked into converting a specially crafted APNG file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to obtain sensitive information or cause a denial of service. (CVE-2017-6960)  Dileep Kumar Jallepalli discovered that apng2gif did not limit the size of memory allocations when reading APNG chunks. If a user or automated  system were tricked into converting a specially crafted APNG file, an  attacker could possibly use this issue to cause apng2gif to crash, resulting  in a denial of service. (CVE-2017-6961)  Dileep Kumar Jallepalli discovered that apng2gif incorrectly handled certain  chunk sizes, leading to an integer overflow and a heap-based buffer overflow.  If a user or automated system were tricked into converting a specially crafted  APNG file, an attacker could possibly use this issue to cause apng2gif to crash, resulting in a denial of service, or possibly execute arbitrary code. (CVE-2017-6962)

statements.status_notes: Several security issues were fixed in apng2gif. Available with Ubuntu Pro.
